rationale: Reallocated the recurrent-tail FP16 export budget away from the earlier tail K path and toward the tail V path while still keeping Q for both recurrent blocks and K on the final block. This is a compact, compile-stable change aimed directly at the strongest remaining local signal: recurrent-tail value-path float rescue under the reverse-tail curriculum, without adding new training-time structure or bloating the script.
title: Reverse-Tail Value-Path Float Reallocation
